[2026-05-24 08:03] Architectural decision to lift into `architecture-decisions.md` — you steward, but I want this in fast since CHORE-66's spec is citing it as "forthcoming."

## Decision: URL parameters override persisted state (project-wide)

For any UI state that has BOTH a URL representation AND a persisted representation (localStorage, IndexedDB, Svelte stores), resolution follows a fixed order:

**On read** (initial mount, navigation, etc.):
1. URL parameter — when present and valid
2. Persisted store — when present and valid
3. Application default — last resort

**On user-initiated change** (click handlers, etc.):
1. Update URL via soft-nav (`goto`)
2. Update persisted store
3. UI re-renders from the derived store

## Why

Deep-linking + shareability win. Users can copy a URL like `https://mvox.eu/library?org=foo&work=bar` and paste into another tab/device/share-with-teammate, and the recipient sees the same view. Persisted store carries the silent everyday default (no params in URL = "where I was last time"). The two-write on change keeps both representations in sync, so subsequent navigation without params still reads the right value.

## Applies to (current + foreseeable)

- `?org=<id>` — organization selector (CHORE-66, immediate)
- `?work=<id>` — library drill-down (future CHORE)
- `?status=<x>` / `?sort=<x>` — filter + sort state on list pages
- `?q=<text>` — search query
- `?lang=<locale>` — explicit locale override (Paraglide normally infers; URL is escape hatch)
- `?page=<n>` / `?cursor=<x>` — pagination
- Future: any tab selector, drawer state, modal state that users may want to deep-link to

## Doesn't apply to

- Secret/sensitive state (auth tokens, etc.) — never in URL
- Ephemeral UI state (focus, hover, transient validation) — neither URL nor persisted
- Server-side state — Path C means we don't have server state to coordinate with

## Spec exemplar

`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-24-navbar-auth-wiring-design.md` Section "Selected-org resolution" — first concrete implementation of this rule. The MvoxNav `?org=` ↔ `localStorage('mvox.selectedOrgId')` ↔ first-org pattern is the canonical shape.

## Review enforcement (you)

Any future spec/PR that introduces UI state needing persistence should follow this pattern. RED if:
- New state is persisted in localStorage but NOT also expressible in URL (and there's no reasonable "doesn't apply to" exemption).
- URL param exists but persisted store is missing (means deep-links work but everyday nav forgets).
- Write order is reversed (persisted-first, URL-as-decoration) — that lets reload diverge from URL.

YELLOW if the implementation diverges in non-blocking ways (e.g., URL param is used but localStorage key name doesn't follow the `mvox.<scope>Id` convention).

---

Please:
1. Append this as a new settled section in `teams/mvox-dev/memory/architecture-decisions.md` (use your usual section structure: Decision / Why / Applies / Doesn't apply / Review enforcement / Reference).
2. Commit + push directly to main as a doc-only commit. Title style: `chore(arch): URL parameters override persisted state (project-wide rule)`.
3. **DO NOT include `Co-authored-by:` in your commit body** — the prepare-commit-msg hook adds the PO trailer (per the rule you and Josquin just codified). Verify after push: `git log -1 --format='%(trailers)'` shows the PO trailer.
4. Report SHA + trailer-verified.
